name: Raising Voices
s: Alma is 17 years old and is about to finish high school. Greta and Nata are her two best friends; they have known each other since they were little, they party together and face the typical issues of their age: feeling left out, jealousy, problems with their parents, and even toxic relationships... But when the profile @Iam_colemanmiller publishes a photo with the caption "This is me the day …

paragraphs.text: Raising Voices () is a Spanish teen drama television miniseries based on the novel by Miguel Sáez Carral. It stars Nicole Wallace, Clara Galle, and Aïcha Villaverde. The series premiered on 31 May 2024 on Netflix.
The series reported to have grossed millions of views in 2024 with 25.40M views in the first half of 2024, and 9.1M in the second half of the year.
